AnalysisVersion.description: Schema tag of the analysis report.

ComplexEdge.description: The complex-graph edge of one reaction, as indices into `complexes`.

ConeLimits.description: Deterministic caps of one cone enumeration; requested values above the hard caps are lowered to them.

max_rays.description: Most intermediate rays kept at any step, at most 4096.

max_work.description: Most work units (arithmetic steps) spent, at most 2000000.

ConeReport.description: Extreme rays of the non-negative conservation cone {l ≥ 0 : lᵀN = 0} and the count bounds they prove. Unless the status is `exact`, rays are empty and every bound is null.

diagnostics.description: `CRN-W012` to `CRN-W015` when the status is not `exact`.

extreme_rays.description: Every extreme ray as a primitive integer law, sorted by coefficients.

initial_class_upper_bounds.description: Per species, the smallest floor(initial_total / coefficient) over the rays, as a decimal string; null when no ray bounds the species. Valid in the initial conservation class only.

ConeStatus.description: Whether the non-negative conservation cone was enumerated completely.

ConservationLaw.description: One conservation law: integer weights l with lᵀN = 0, so the weighted total of counts never changes.

coefficients.description: Primitive integer coefficients, encoded as strings to preserve i128 values. One per species, in species order.

initial_total.description: The conserved total lᵀx₀ at the initial counts, as a decimal integer string.

ConservationReport.description: Linear conservation laws of the network and the count bounds they prove.

basis.description: Basis of the rational conservation space, with non-negative rows exposed where a simple combination allows it; empty unless the status is `exact`.

diagnostics.description: `CRN-W010` or `CRN-W011` when the basis is unavailable.

initial_class_upper_bounds.description: Proven using non-negative basis rows only; None is not an unboundedness proof. One entry per species: floor(initial_total / coefficient), minimized over the rows, as a decimal string. It bounds the species in the initial conservation class only.

rank.description: Rank of the stoichiometric matrix N; absent unless the status is `exact`. An exact basis has species − rank rows.

ConservationStatus.description: Whether the linear conservation basis was computed.

Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

LinkageReport.description: Complex graph of the network and its components; species and complex indices are zero-based.

complexes.description: First occurrence order while visiting each reaction's reactants/products. Each complex is a sparse species vector; the empty complex is an empty list.

deficiency.description: Absent when the exact stoichiometric rank is unavailable. Otherwise complexes − linkage classes − rank.

linkage_classes.description: Connected components of the undirected complex graph, as sorted complex indices.

reaction_edges.description: One edge per reaction, in reaction order.

strong_linkage_classes.description: Strongly connected components of the directed complex graph.

terminal_strong_linkage_classes.description: Strong linkage classes that no edge leaves.

weakly_reversible.description: Whether every linkage class is strongly connected.

NetworkAnalysis.description: Structure, rates and conservation analysis of a successfully lowered model.

dependencies.description: Sorted propensity invalidations for each fired reaction index.

evaluation_counts.description: The state at which propensities were evaluated: the supplied state, or the initial counts. It need not lie in the initial conservation class.

initial_class_upper_bounds.description: Cone bounds when exact, otherwise sound linear-basis bounds. Null means not proved, not unbounded.

propensities.description: Propensity of each reaction at `evaluation_counts`, in events per unit time.

reactions.description: Indexed reactions (the channels of the flat view) in rule declaration order.

species.description: Species labels of the flat view (for a network model its species names in declaration order); this order indexes every other per-species list.

ReactionStructure.description: Indexed structure of one reaction (a channel of the flat view), with terms sorted by species index.

name.description: The name of the reaction's rule; the channels of a rule with several reactant tuples share it.

net_changes.description: One stoichiometric matrix column: products minus reactants, zeros omitted.

reactants.description: Consumed species and coefficients; they also gate the channel.

reads.description: Conservative reads, including reactant gates and the species of every observable the rate reads.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

Term.description: Sparse entry. Indices refer to the report's `species` list.

coefficient.description: Stoichiometric coefficient: positive on reactant and product sides, signed in net changes.

description: Result of `analyze`: success flag, input hashes, the analysis and every diagnostic.

analysis.description: The analysis when `success` is true, otherwise null.

diagnostics.description: On success the structural warnings (`CRN-W001` dropped for species with a proven bound, `CRN-W002`, `CRN-W003`) and the conservation and cone warnings; on failure the diagnostics of the failed step.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model bytes; null only when the model file could not be read.

simulation_available.description: Always false: analysis runs no simulation.

state_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact state bytes when a state was supplied.

success.description: True when the model was lowered and every propensity evaluated. Conservation or cone limits leave it true and show up in their status fields.

title: AnalysisReport
